prompt: Spring Boot server.tomcat.processor-cache negative value behavior
answer: A negative `server.tomcat.processor-cache` value means unlimited processor caching. Specifically, `-1` means unlimited. A value of `0` disables request-processor reuse. ([Spring Boot issue #14991](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/14991), [Tomcat documentation](https://tomcat.apache.org/tomcat-10.1-doc/config/http.html))
